step.description: step is the step that the blocker is about. It is left out when the blocker is about the cluster.

Blocker.description: Blocker is one reason a plan cannot run.

BlockerKind.description: BlockerKind is why a plan cannot run.

version.description: version is the Kubernetes version of the control plane, and TargetVersion the version that an upgrade or a rollback moves to.

gate.description: gate is the verdict of the health gate. It is left out when no gate ran: nothing would be submitted, or --skip-health-check.

rollback.description: rollback is the upgrade that a rollback undoes.

results.description: results has one entry for each step of the plan, in plan order.

verification.description: verification are the checks that ran after the change.

ClusterRun.description: ClusterRun is the plan for one cluster and what the run did with it.

name.description: name identifies the item. For a Region failure it is the region.

cluster.description: cluster is the cluster that the item belongs to.

operation.description: operation is the IAM action that failed, such as "eks:DescribeNodegroup".

retryable.description: retryable reports whether the same command, run again with no other change, may succeed.

error.description: error is one line of text for people. Do not parse it; use Reason.

awsErrorCode.description: awsErrorCode is the AWS API error code, such as AccessDeniedException, when AWS answered.

updateId.description: updateId is the EKS update ID, for a failure of a started update.

Failure.description: Failure is one item that refresh could not read, or one action that it tried and that did not complete.

FailureKind.description: FailureKind is the type of item a Failure is about.

Failures.description: Failures is the failure list of a document. A nil list encodes as [], so a document always has its failures key as a list.

reasons.description: reasons are the checks behind the decision, worst first, as "check: message".

accepted.description: accepted are the reasons that --yes went past.

forced.description: forced are the reasons that --force went past.

Gate.description: Gate is the verdict of the health gate in a plan or a run.

GateDecision.description: GateDecision is the verdict of the health gate of a change.

HealthOutcome.description: HealthOutcome is what a health check found.

blocking.description: blocking is true when a Fail of this check blocks a change.

message.description: message is one line about what the check found.

findings.description: findings name the things behind a Warn or a Fail, such as the nodes that are not ready.

HealthResult.description: HealthResult is the result of one health check.

Operation.description: Operation is the change that a plan or a run is about.

PhaseKind.description: PhaseKind names a phase of a change.

PlanDecision.description: PlanDecision is what a real run of a plan would do first.

hop.description: hop is the Kubernetes version that the phase of an upgrade moves to.

name.description: name is the nodegroup or the add-on. It is left out for the control plane.

from.description: from and To are the versions: the Kubernetes version for a roll and the control plane, the add-on version for an add-on.

toRelease.description: toRelease is the AMI release that a roll expects.

force.description: force is true when the request carries the force flag.

PlanStep.description: PlanStep is one step of a plan.

upgradedAt.description: upgradedAt is when the upgrade to the current version started. EKS counts the window from when it finished, so the dates are approximate.

insights.description: insights counts the ROLLBACK_READINESS insights by status. It is left out when they could not be read.

Rollback.description: Rollback says that the cluster can roll back to its previous minor version, and until when.

RunStatus.description: RunStatus is how a run, or the part of it for one cluster, ended.

ScaleSizes.description: ScaleSizes are the sizes of a nodegroup before and after a scale.

Sizes.description: Sizes are the scaling sizes of a nodegroup.

StepAction.description: StepAction is what a run does with a step.

hop.description: hop is the Kubernetes version that the phase of an upgrade moves to.

name.description: name is the nodegroup or the add-on. It is left out for the control plane.

StepID.description: StepID identifies a step within its cluster: phase, hop, kind, and name together. No field is a composite ID to parse.

StepKind.description: StepKind names what a step changes.

StepReason.description: StepReason is why a step has its action.

hop.description: hop is the Kubernetes version that the phase of an upgrade moves to.

name.description: name is the nodegroup or the add-on. It is left out for the control plane.

attached.description: attached is true when the run waited for a change that it did not start.

inFlight.description: inFlight is the type of the update that made a Busy step busy: VersionUpdate, ConfigUpdate, or AddonUpdate. It is left out when the update was not found.

failure.description: failure is why the step did not succeed. It is also in the failures list of the document.

StepResult.description: StepResult is what a run did with one step of the plan.

StepStatus.description: StepStatus is what a run did with one step.

apiVersion.description: The version of the document contract.

failures.description: Every failure of the run: the items that refresh could not read and the actions that did not complete. The list is sorted by kind, region, cluster, name, and operation. It is [] when there are no failures.

title: Run
description: The document that `refresh addon update -o json` prints. -o yaml prints the same structure.
